title: Return to the Secret Realm
next_chapter_hook: The three-month countdown officially begins. Chen Ji holds the third page of the Tianji Record and the coordinates to the seventh-layer Forbidden Grounds in his hand—the next storm is about to arrive.

text.content: Chen Ji's grip on the broken Voice Transmission Jade Pendant tightened until his knuckles turned white. Within three months, he would personally trample the Holy Sect into dust—and before that, he had to become stronger.

The ultimate trial of the first layer of the Secret Realm is an altar suspended in the Void. At its center stands an ancient bronze mirror, its surface reflecting not human figures, but countless intertwined threads of fate—red, white, black, densely layered like a spider's web.

dialogue.content: "This is the Causality Mirror." Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind. "It shows the whereabouts of those connected to you by causality within three days. Pass this trial, and you will truly have reached the Golden Core realm."

text.content: Chen Ji stepped toward the altar. With each step, the surrounding threads of fate trembled violently. He saw Su Qingyao practicing sword forms in the Inner Sect Martial Arena, her blade light sharp yet tinged with anxiety; he saw Ye Qing open her eyes in the Demon Path Holy Sect's confinement chamber, a诡异的 smile curling at her lips; he saw Ling Yuan seated in a secret chamber at the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, surrounded by suffocating pressure—and on the chamber wall hung a map of the Chen Family Ancestral Land.

He continued forward. Another step, and the threads of fate suddenly snapped and reformed, revealing more scenes: Han Lie battling fiercely at the Xuanwu Sect, blood staining his battle robes as he laughed wildly; a team of mysterious black-robed figures infiltrating the Tianqing Sect territory; and a blurry figure imprisoned in the lightless underground, clutching a broken Jade Pendant tightly in their arms.

"Chen Nian..." Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply, his fist clenching violently. The Chen Family crest was carved on that Jade Pendant—it was the legacy his father left for his sister. He drew a deep breath, forcibly suppressing his churning emotions, never stopping his steps as he walked straight toward the Causality Mirror.

When his fingertip touched the mirror's surface, a powerful force surged forth from within, washing over his meridians. The spiritual power in his dantian churned like boiling lava, golden light erupting from his body and condensing above his head into a radiant虚影 of a Golden Core.

dialogue.content: "It's done." Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a rare note of satisfaction. "Golden Core established, the third page of the Tianji Record fully awakened. Causality Tracing—from today onward, you can perceive the movements of those connected to you by causality within three days. This is a qualitative leap in your Foresight Ability."

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, sensing the changes within his body. The Golden Core floated at the center of his dantian, emanating a warm yet gentle light. His meridians had widened by thirty percent, and the speed of spiritual power circulation had increased severalfold. He casually waved his hand, a sword qi howling forth and splitting the boulder ten zhang away into two clean halves, the cut smooth as a mirror.

"So this is the power of the Golden Core realm..." he murmured to himself, a flash of satisfaction crossing his eyes. However, in the next moment, his expression suddenly froze—the third page of the Tianji Record slowly unfolded in his Mental Sea, revealing words that chilled his heart: Causality Tracing allows tracing the movements of those connected by causality within three days, but each use consumes 10 points of Heavenly Fate.

choice.prompt: The third page of the Tianji Record fully awakened, numerous causal images flowing through his mind. Which lead should Chen Ji prioritize?

choices.description: The blurry image haunted him—the location where his sister was imprisoned had to be confirmed.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key clues to Chen Nian's location
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate is already scarce—further consumption may affect future plans

text.content: Chen Ji activated his Causality Tracing ability, a golden light flickering in his pupils. In an instant, countless scenes flashed by like a carousel—Section Seven of the Holy Sect's underground, a crystal prison cell covered in prohibition runes, within which a young girl's appearance was withered yet her gaze resolute, her hand gripping the Jade Pendant as if it were her final obsession.
"Section Seven... the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds." Chen Ji murmured, his killing intent surging. This lead, he would remember.

choices.description: The mysterious force appearing in the Tianqing Sect territory poses an unknown threat level—they must be assessed first.
choices.visible_reward: Discover details of the enemy's布局
choices.risk_hint: May expose his abilities, alerting the enemy

text.content: The Causality Tracing unfolded, and Chen Ji saw clearly where those black-robed figures came from—their sleeves bore a crescent moon emblem, the remnants of the Crescent Moon Sect, which the three major sects had jointly destroyed. Their target was unmistakably the Tianqing Sect's Scripture Repository, intending to steal the incantation for opening the Ancient Forbidden Land.
"Interesting." A cold smile curved Chen Ji's lips. "Using others as knives—I know this tactic all too well."

choices.description: Heavenly Fate is precious and should not be wasted casually. Keep the clues in mind and settle accounts later.
choices.risk_hint: May miss immediate intelligence, losing the initiative

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew his gaze, suppressing the impulse in his heart. Those images had already been deeply etched into his mind—without consuming Heavenly Fate, he could deduce seventy to eighty percent. The priority was leaving the Secret Realm and consolidating his cultivation; the rest of the accounts could wait.

He turned toward the transmission formation behind the altar. In his heart, he had already filed away everything he'd witnessed: Chen Nian in Section Seven of the Holy Sect, the Crescent Moon Sect remnants plotting against the Scripture Repository, Ling Yuan's unresolved connection to the Chen Family Ancestral Land... these leads were enough for him to scheme for a long time.

The transmission formation blazed with light, and Chen Ji felt his vision blur as a gentle force enveloped him, carrying him through the spatial rift. When the light faded, he stood in the valley at the Secret Realm's exit.

However, he did not leave immediately. At the valley entrance, a withered yet authoritative figure stood with hands clasped behind his back, as if waiting for some time. Ling Yuan, the former Sect Master of Tianqing Sect—the old fox who outwardly sheltered him while secretly harboring malice, had finally dropped all pretense and appeared before him.

dialogue.content: "Advanced to Golden Core?" Ling Yuan turned around, a flash of sharpness crossing his clouded old eyes. "Three days earlier than this old man anticipated. Chen Family bloodline, truly extraordinary."
"The Former Sect Master personally welcoming me—I am overwhelmed." Chen Ji slightly bowed, his tone respectful yet distant. "May I ask why the Former Sect Master waits here?"

"This old man came to see you off." Ling Yuan stepped forward slowly, each step raising suffocating pressure. "Incidentally, a reminder—the ones chosen by the Tianji Record never meet good ends. The previous holder died under the joint siege of the three major sects; the one before that was betrayed by those they trusted most. Do you think you will be the exception?"

text.content: Chen Ji stood in place, allowing that pressure to weigh upon him like a mountain. His expression remained calm as still water, only his hands hidden in his sleeves secretly clenching—then slowly relaxing the next moment. He raised his head,直视 Ling Yuan's eyes, and smiled faintly.

dialogue.content: "The Former Sect Master is right—the Tianji Record's holders do meet bad ends." Chen Ji's voice was unhurried. "But the Former Sect Master seems to have forgotten one thing—those chosen by the Tianji Record are often the ones who laugh last. After all, those the Tianji Record personally moves to deal with are never soft targets."

text.content: Ling Yuan's eyelids twitched slightly. This statement was too direct, almost showing his hand—he knew Ling Yuan's true colors. Yet出乎意料, the old man did not fly into a rage; instead, he let out a profound laugh.

dialogue.content: "Interesting." Ling Yuan stepped aside, clearing the path for Chen Ji. "In three months, Section Seven of the Forbidden Grounds opens. This old man will be waiting for you there—perhaps then, you may need this old man's assistance."

text.content: Chen Ji gave no response, simply walking past Ling Yuan. The moment they brushed shoulders, the old man's low voice sounded beside his ear—

dialogue.content: "Chen Family bloodline should not end with my generation."

text.content: This sentence made Chen Ji's steps pause momentarily. He did not look back, merely saying淡声道："Former Sect Master's words, Chen Ji will remember." With that, he strode away from the valley. Behind him, Ling Yuan's gaze, like a venomous snake, firmly fixed on his retreating back,久久不曾移开.

When Chen Ji returned to the Tianqing Sect, it was already dusk. The moment he stepped into his secluded servant's hut, he sensed something amiss—a strange Jade Slip lay quietly on the table, as if it had been waiting for some time.

dialogue.content: "..." Chen Ji's brow slightly furrowed. He had laid三重restriction on this room; an ordinary person could not possibly enter silently. He picked up the Jade Slip and probed with his神识—two lines of text appeared: 'See you at the second layer.' At the bottom, a faint green lotus seal.

text.content: Green lotus... Chen Ji fell into contemplation. Those capable of accomplishing all this under his nose were extremely rare. Su Qingyao? Or the mysterious benefactor? He tucked the Jade Slip into his怀, his gaze drifting to the darkening scenery beyond the window. The three-month deadline had begun.

He spread open his palm, the third page of the Tianji Record's information circulating in his Mental Sea: Causality Tracing ability fully unlocked, can trace causality connections within three days, consuming 10 points of Heavenly Fate per use. And in his hand, he still gripped the Jade Slip with coordinates to the seventh-layer Forbidden Grounds, along with that mysterious Jade Slip reading 'See you at the second layer.'

choice.prompt: Three Jade Slips, three paths. How should Chen Ji arrange his next move?

choices.description: The recently advanced Golden Core realm still needs tempering—rash action would only be counterproductive.
choices.visible_reward: Golden Core foundations stabilize, Combat Power further increases
choices.risk_hint: May miss the timing, allowing enemies to take the lead

text.content: Chen Ji decided to enter seclusion for seven days. He kept the three Jade Slips close to his body, set concealment formations in the servant's hut, and began circulating his cultivation technique to consolidate the Golden Core. After seven days, when he emerged, his气息steady如渊, a completely different person from seven days prior.
At this moment, news spread through the Tianqing Sect: Su Qingyao was searching everywhere for him, seemingly having noticed something. Chen Ji smiled faintly—it was time to meet this红颜知己.

choices.text: Take the initiative, eliminate the Crescent Moon Sect remnants
choices.description: Since the enemy's plot is known, strike first, nipping the threat in the bud.

text.content: Following the guidance of Causality Tracing, Chen Ji infiltrated the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain by night. The Crescent Moon Sect remnants were surveying the perimeter of the Scripture Repository; their leader was merely at late Foundation Building cultivation—in the face of his Golden Core realm strength, they were like ants.

An incense stick's time later, Chen Ji brushed the dust from his robes and vanished into the night. Four members of the Crescent Moon Sect, none survived. From the leader's body, he retrieved a secret letter; the contact codename mentioned within made his brow rise—the "Insider · Green Lotus."

choices.description: The enemy is暗处, we are明处. Rash action will only disturb the grass and alert the snake—better to静制动.
choices.visible_reward: Gather more intelligence, set up counter traps
choices.risk_hint: May fall被动, be led by the enemy's nose

text.content: Chen Ji did not act rashly. He secretly planted pieces on the board, monitoring every move of the Crescent Moon Sect remnants. Simultaneously, he contacted Ye Qing through secret channels, asking her to use the Demon Path Holy Sect's intelligence network to investigate the "Green Lotus's" true identity.

Three days later, Ye Qing sent a secret report: 'Green Lotus' is an Inner Sect Elder of Tianqing Sect named Qin Qinglian, one of the witnesses who had accused the Chen Family of treason back then. A cold light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes—this account, it was time to settle.
Just then, knocking came at the door. Chen Ji收敛气息, tucked the Jade Slip into his怀, and saidsaid in a deep voice道："Who is it?"

dialogue.content: "It's me." A cold female voice came from outside. "Su Qingyao. Chen Ji, open the door—I have something to ask you."

text.content: A slight smile curved Chen Ji's lips. This Inner Disciple Senior Fellow's nose was sharp indeed, finding him so quickly. He rose and opened the door to see Su Qingyao standing outside in a pure white long dress, her beautiful eyes carrying scrutiny and exploration. She looked Chen Ji up and down, her brow furrowing: "You've... broken through?"

dialogue.content: "Good fortune—I encountered a stroke of luck in the Secret Realm." Chen Ji stepped aside, making an inviting gesture. "Senior Sister Su's late-night visit—what brings you here?"

Su Qingyao did not enter, merely staring into his eyes, as if trying to see through to some flaw: "Last night, there was异动 in the Back Mountain Forbidden Grounds—someone saw黑影 appearing. Do you... know something?"

text.content: Chen Ji understood in his heart. The Crescent Moon Sect matter had already alarmed the Sect, and Su Qingyao as Inner Disciple Senior Fellow naturally had to investigate. His face revealed nothing, merely showing an innocent苦笑: "Black shadows? Senior Sister, I'm just a servant disciple who rarely even goes to the Outer Court—how would I know about such things?"

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao coldly snorted: "You think I don't know? That expression of yours in front of the Scripture Repository that day—I saw it clearly. Chen Ji, there are too many不对劲 about you—but I won't press for now." She paused, her voice softening slightly: "I only hope you know—no matter what happens, don't put yourself in danger."

text.content: This sentence made Chen Ji slightly怔住. He looked into Su Qingyao's eyes—there was scrutiny, doubt, but more than anything... something he hadn't felt in a long time. He lowered his eyes and said softly: "Thank you for your concern, Senior Sister Su. Chen Ji knows his limits."

Su Qingyao gave him a deep look, seeming to want to say something, but ultimately could only softly sigh: "When Section Seven of the Forbidden Grounds opens in three months, I hope by then... you're still alive." With that, she turned and left, her white figure quickly vanishing into the night.

Chen Ji closed the door and returned to sit on the bed. In his hand he held the three Jade Slips, his eyes flashing with complex light. Three months, seventy-odd days—neither long nor short. Enough for him to set his pieces, and enough for him to... settle all outstanding accounts.

Beyond the window, moonlight fell like frost. The Tianqing Sect night was as serene as ever, but Chen Ji knew—a storm was coming. He closed his eyes, the third page of the Tianji Record slowly appearing in his Mental Sea, golden text glowing brilliantly—Causality Tracing, causality intertwined, the trends of the world, all within the palm.

The three-month countdown officially begins. Chen Ji holds the third page of the Tianji Record and the coordinates to the seventh-layer Forbidden Grounds in his hand—the next storm is about to arrive. And those enemies hidden in the darkness—the Crescent Moon Sect remnants, the Holy Sect's hidden hand, the Chen Family blood feud—they will all, one by one, reveal themselves in his chess game.
